extension.summary: Full-featured IPTV player – M3U, Xtream Codes, EPG, VOD, Series, Favorites, Catch-up
Vollständiger IPTV-Player – M3U, Xtream Codes, EPG, VOD, Serien, Favoriten, Catch-up
extension.description: A complete IPTV addon ported from TiViMate for Kodi 21. Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series), XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings, reminders, sleep timer.

Ein vollständiges IPTV-Addon für Kodi 21. Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien), XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen, Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
extension.news: German and English language support; Language filter; Xtream auto-detection; Parallel search
